ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Mars

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Venus retrograde in your relationships sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Venus retrograde in your romance sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Venus retrograde in your communication sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Venus retrograde in your self-image sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Treat yourself to a small comfort that costs almost nothing.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Wear a colour you really love and notice how it changes your mood.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Venus retrograde in your friendship sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Switch off your phone an hour before bed.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Introduce two people who could help each other.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Venus retrograde in your horizons sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Think of one small step that brings you closer to your big dream.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Read something that inspires you and keep one sentence.
